words.headline: Tuesday Radiator Roll Call: No-Heat Calls More Than Double to 2,555
words.blurb: With a low of 35 degrees, no-heat-or-hot-water calls reached 2,555, more than twice the usual 1,238. Whole-building outages led the way at 1,286 reports.

boroughs.Bronx: No heat led with 850 calls, the most of any borough, with home repairs close behind.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled with 1,161 calls, though 671 no-heat calls pushed into second.
boroughs.Manhattan: No heat topped the list at 585, ahead of home repairs and noise.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars led with 851 calls, and no heat took second at 401.
boroughs.Staten Island: A quiet borough: parking wars led with just 76, trailed by trash talk.

rare_finds.name: Used car dealer: catalytic converter purchase records inadequate
rare_finds.quip: The city has a category for exhaust-part paperwork being thin. Somewhere a filing cabinet is the only thing on the lot still fully intact.

rare_finds.name: Beach/pool/sauna unpermitted
rare_finds.quip: STATUS: Steam located without a permit. Agency drafting a response. Estimated arrival: once the sauna cools to room temperature.

rare_finds.name: For-profit college or university: advertising false or misleading
